test_permission_error_detection: test the ProxyExtrasDBManager to detect PostgreSQL permission denied and must be owner errors
test_idempotent_error_detection: test the ProxyExtrasDBManager to detect already exists and duplicate key idempotent errors
test_error_classification_priority: test that permission errors are not classified as idempotent errors and vice versa
test_custom_prisma_dir: test the ProxyExtrasDBManager prisma directory configuration using the LITELLM_MIGRATION_DIR environment variable
test_migration_sql_idempotency: test all migration SQL files use idempotent DDL patterns like IF NOT EXISTS and IF EXISTS
